limitations: Done returned to the same task row. The final disk read followed deferred app termination, so effects_closed does not establish when native retirement completed.

The bundled validator retains its historical key-rotation entry point. This run invoked its helper with the exact three quarantine offers.
The runner checked the original sandbox and XCTest outputs, then removed them. Independent review used the retained observations, products and packet.
The FieldLog revision, staged archive and linked VM archive were provenance pins in the independent review.
